summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases at npm install time and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js, a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS blob with string-array shuffling (function WV8StW rotates a large opaque identifier/string table at runtime). If Bun is already present locally, that binary is used directly against the same obfuscated file. The wrapper performs no hash or signature verification of the downloaded runtime, and math_init.js is opaque JavaScript that cannot be statically reviewed. The obfuscated payload is not referenced from any other module in the package — its only invocation is via the preinstall dropper — so installing the package causes arbitrary attacker-authored code to run on the installer host under the Bun runtime, bypassing scanners that inspect only Node-resolved code paths.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
